name: JHTDB turbulent subgrid stress
description: closure(filtered_velocity, gradients, filter_width) -> N x N x N x 3 x 3 symmetric subgrid stress. Complete periodic source DNS boxes (not wrapped cutouts) supply independent box-filtered ground truth. Whole space-time blocks split. Score stress and energy-transfer errors plus Fourier energy error after evaluator RK2 coarse rollout. Galilean and cyclic rotational consistency and rollout stability required.

papers.title: Deep Neural Networks for Data-Driven Turbulence Models
papers.task_relation: The local task predicts subgrid stresses from filtered periodic JHTDB turbulence, with energy-transfer, invariance, and rollout checks. Its flow selection, tensor target, and scoring differ from the published closure construction; JHTDB supplies data rather than the importance evidence.
papers.primary_goal: Learn closure terms from direct numerical simulation and use them to construct accurate, stable large-eddy simulations.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Model unresolved turbulent stresses accurately enough to improve coarse large-eddy simulations.
